# Source provenance

`protocol/` and `web/` were copied from the user's existing `quic-mordern-library/packages` project on September 14, 2026. Both package manifests declare version 0.1.0 and MIT licensing. The source project did not contain a root license file, so no copyright holder or license grant has been invented here. Preserve and confirm upstream attribution before redistributing the snapshot externally.

`server/src/certs.rs` is also derived from that project's test-server certificate helper. This app uses its own fleet backend; it does not modify or replace the original library project.
